caption: The drawing features a horizontal strip centered on a beige or off-white background. The strip consists of two main sections: the upper section displays a red and yellow Greek key pattern bordered by solid red and yellow lines, while the lower section has a dark green background with a decorative vine. The vine is light green with white, shadowed leaves and flower buds arranged along its length, and its tendrils extend horizontally across the strip. The lower edge of the strip is bordered by a thin black line. The rest of the page is empty except for an inscription or signature in the lower right corner.
title: Wall Paper
